2022.notes: 1 match unrecoverable via automated scraping: Internacional vs Botafogo RJ (fixture-list match_id=3821299). FotMob has reassigned this match_id to a future (2026-10-24) fixture between the same clubs. Investigated two ways: (1) live matchDetails API - returns the future fixture, finished=false; (2) raw server-rendered HTML (__NEXT_DATA__), captured before any client-side JS runs - also shows the future fixture. Both independently confirm the original 2022 match data is not being served under this ID anywhere we can reach it programmatically. DEFERRED: needs manual lookup (e.g. FotMob mobile app, alternate match-archive site, or league standings page) to confirm final score/stats if this match is needed later. Coverage: 379/380 (99.7%).
